title: Uncharted — Greatness from small beginnings

hook.context: Bu lotincha ibora — "kichik boshlanishdan buyuklik". Sir Francis Drake shiori bo'lgan va Nathan uni uzugiga o'yib yozdirgan. Ingliz tilida ham iqtibos sifatida ishlatiladi.

reading: Nathan Drake grew up in an orphanage in Boston with his older brother Sam. As boys, they used to sneak into museums and dream about finding lost treasure.
When Sam ran away, he promised to come back for Nate, but he never did. Years later, Nate works as a bartender and picks up small things from rich customers' pockets.
One evening a treasure hunter, Victor "Sully" Sullivan, turns up at the bar. He says he knows Sam and asks Nate to help him look for the gold of Magellan's lost ships.
Nate doesn't trust Sully, but he can't turn down the chance to find his brother. They set off together on a dangerous journey from New York to Barcelona and the Philippines.
They have to work out old clues hidden in maps, churches and tunnels. A rich man, Moncada, is also after the treasure, and he doesn't give up easily.
In the most famous scene, Nate falls out of a plane and has to hold on to boxes that are hanging in the air.
In the end, they find the ships, but they can't take much gold with them. Still, Nate has found something more important: a partner, and a clue that his brother is still alive.

grammar.title: Phrasal verbs: ajraladigan va ajralmaydigan
explain: **Phrasal verb** = fe'l + kichik so'z (up, down, off, out, on...). Ma'no ko'pincha butunlay o'zgaradi: **turn up** (paydo bo'lmoq), **turn down** (rad etmoq), **give up** (voz kechmoq).

**Ajraladigan** (to'ldiruvchili): obyekt o'rtada yoki oxirida bo'lishi mumkin: turn down **the offer** / turn **the offer** down. Lekin **olmosh** faqat o'rtada: turn **it** down (turn down it — xato).
**Ajralmaydigan**: obyekt doim oxirida: **look after** the kids, **look for** the gold, **get on** the plane, **hold on to** the box.
To'ldiruvchisiz phrasal verbs: **set off**, **turn up**, **grow up**, **run away** — ular ortidan obyekt kelmaydi: Sam **ran away**.
